delimiter.description: The character used to delimit the device name and partition number in the mapped device name (e.g., -p '_'). Must be a single character.

sync.description: If true, kpartx runs in sync mode (-s), blocking until partitions are created. If false, runs in nosync mode (-n).

force.description: If true, forces creation of mappings even if the 'no_partitions' feature is set (-f).

gpt_force.description: If true, forces use of GUID Partition Table (GPT) parsing (-g).

readonly.description: If true, creates read-only partition mappings (-r).
